subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google documents the product as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The source issue is reproducible, but the requested wording differs from Google’s current docs and the repository must avoid accidentally renaming a stable provider/config surface.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new official name with the existing Vertex/provider-id mental model.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave the current copy until Google APIs, SDKs, and OpenClaw docs are ready for a coordinated terminology change.

options.title: Use a shorter Gemini Enterprise label
options.body: Adopt a shorter UI label but document that it still maps to the stable `google-vertex` provider id and Vertex ADC setup.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update only user-facing labels and docs to bridge the new official name with the existing Vertex/provider-id mental model.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question is UI/docs/product wording, and the issue discussion specifically routes that decision to this login.
